utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, are you coming to the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park and working at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm definitely in! What time should I be there, and where exactly are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! We're meeting at the park at 9 AM to start with the benches, then move to the community center for electronics. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I know it starts at 2 PM, but the date and location still aren't set. I'm waiting to hear more before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it's this Saturday at the park.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Are you sure? I thought we were still waiting on the date and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira! The repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM. I'm helping coordinate around school schedules, so let me know if you need a specific time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure it's this Saturday? I haven't seen any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm certain—I heard it from Leo and Tess. It's this Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Cleo, I keep getting mixed up. Is it electronics or the community center this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's the repair drive, Noah — we're fixing up electronics and maybe a few things at the community center too. This Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, both electronics and community center. Thanks for clearing that up, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, this Saturday? I haven't heard anything official about the date—are you sure?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm sure! Leo told me it's this Saturday at 9 AM at his garage. We're fixing up old electronics.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds different from what I heard—I thought it was for park benches, not electronics. And I haven't seen any official notice about this Saturday. Are you sure this is the same event?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Hana, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm planning to bring my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Repair drive? I want to make sure I understand exactly what you need—could you explain a bit more about the issue?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure! It's this Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street—look for a white van with an orange stripe. People bring broken stuff like toasters or lamps, and volunteers try to fix them for free. I heard there might even be Sunday slots if it gets busy!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, does anyone know if we have enough hammers for the repair drive on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, I thought the repair drive is today at Leo's garage? Or did I get the day wrong again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's Sunday afternoon at the community center, not today at Leo's.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, what's the repair drive about? I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's this Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street. Look for the white van with an orange stripe — we'll be fixing up things folks bring by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, white van with orange stripe on Elm Street. Saturday at 2. I'll try to swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Jules, I thought it was on Elm Street? Did they change the location?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nope, it's at the community center this Saturday, not Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: But I heard it was on Sunday, not Saturday. Are you sure it's Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Rosa, repair drive is next Saturday at 9 AM at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually Leo, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Could you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I'll update folks. Sunday at community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Right, Sunday then. I'll be there with my things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, Uli, it's Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Saturday? I must've mixed up the days. I'll be there at Leo's on Saturday then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, did you hear the repair drive this Saturday also includes fixing park benches at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Really? I thought it was next Saturday, but I'm glad to help with the benches too. My tools are ready whenever.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, definitely this Saturday, Gus. Glad you've got your tools ready—the benches could use some TLC.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I heard about the repair drive. I've got some tools I can lend if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, great, thanks Gus! The repair drive is this Saturday at Leo's garage at 9 AM, so your tools will come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem! I'll bring my toolset—got wrenches, screwdrivers, and a drill if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's this Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was at the community center, not Leo's garage. Can you double-check the location?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm pretty sure it's at Leo's garage, that's what I heard from Opal.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive is next Saturday, 9 AM at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wait, Leo, I thought it was this Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street—are you sure about the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No, it's next Saturday at 9 AM at my garage. That's the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I'm on my way to Leo's garage for the repair drive. It's happening right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, right now? I thought it was scheduled for this weekend at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I think there might have been a mix-up. I'm pretty sure it's happening right now at Leo's. Want to come with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, we're having a repair drive this Saturday at the community center—people bring broken items and we fix them together. Want to come by?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought it was at Leo's garage. Are you sure about the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I'm sure—we moved it to the community center because there's more space. I can show you the flyer if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, the repair drive. I think I saw that van this morning. So it's this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center at 2 PM, not on Elm Street. Maybe the van you saw was something else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, I could've sworn I read something about a white van on Elm Street for Saturday. Maybe I got my days mixed up. So it's Sunday at the community center then?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday on Elm Street? That white van with the orange stripe is the drop-off point!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that the repair drive everyone's been talking about? I've heard bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it's this Saturday at 2 PM! You can bring any broken stuff to the van, and neighbors with skills will fix it up. I think they might add Sunday slots too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think we're set for Sunday afternoon. Any issues with that?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, Sunday? I thought the repair drive was this Saturday. Are we doing park benches too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, it's Sunday afternoon. And park benches? I thought it was just the center's broken equipment.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I thought it was at Leo's garage for old electronics, not park benches. Maybe I'm mixing things up again...

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, it's definitely at the park and community center this Saturday! We're sprucing up the benches. You should come—it'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, glad Sunday works for you, Uli. Your roof really needs some attention.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I'll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Uli. See you Sunday, and thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I heard about the repair drive on Saturday at 9 AM. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I think there's been some confusion. I heard it's at 2 PM, but the date isn't set yet. Are you sure about Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm sure. Leo confirmed it's Saturday at 9 AM.
